rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for a debit card, especially when distinguishing it from a credit card.

example.english: This is a debit card, not a credit card; every purchase takes money directly from my bank account.
example.traditional: 呢張係扣賬卡，唔係信用卡，筆筆消費都係直接扣銀行戶口嘅錢。

rows.note: A speaker uses this when focusing on the bank or ATM card used to withdraw money, even when it also functions as a debit card.

example.english: I’m going to withdraw money at the ATM, so remember to bring the debit card.
example.traditional: 我去櫃員機提款，記得帶埋提款卡。
